headline: 3 types of cartilage
stat_note: cartilage is avascular, so it heals slowly
body:
Hyaline: smooth, strong, flexible (nose, ribs)
Fibrocartilage: tough (knee menisci, discs)
Elastic: bends and springs back (outer ear)
source: Source: OpenStax Anatomy & Physiology 2e, 4.3 Connective Tissue

headline: CSF flow path, step by step
stat_note: CSF is made by the choroid plexuses, about 500 mL a day
body:
Lateral ventricles > third ventricle
Cerebral aqueduct > fourth ventricle
Apertures > subarachnoid space
Arachnoid granulations > venous blood
source: Source: OpenStax Anatomy & Physiology 2e, 13.3 Circulation and the CNS
